name: OTel-Embedding-568M
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from BAAI/bge-m3 (config.json max_position_embeddings 8194). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (XLM-RoBERTa), full attention, no causal mask
notes: ADDED 2026-10-27. A finetune of BAAI/bge-m3, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.568 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-02-02.

benchmarks.name: NDCG@10 (OTel-Embedding held-out 10%)
benchmarks.config: Card table 'Metric | Base model | OTel fine-tuned': bge-m3 57.2% vs 89.6% +/-0.6, +32.4pp, bootstrap n=1000. Private telecom retrieval corpus, not a public benchmark.
